directives.name: .macro
directives.description: Begins a macro definition with optional parameters and default values, terminated by .endm.

directives.name: .endm
directives.description: Ends a macro definition started by .macro.

directives.name: .exitm
directives.description: Exits early from the current macro or repeat block expansion.

directives.name: .altmacro
directives.description: Enables alternate macro syntax mode (for example %expr evaluation and & parameter separators).

directives.name: .noaltmacro
directives.description: Disables alternate macro syntax mode and restores standard macro argument handling.

directives.name: .rept
directives.description: Repeats the block of statements up to .endr count times.

directives.name: .irp
directives.description: Repeats the block up to .endr once for each comma-separated value bound to param.

directives.name: .irpc
directives.description: Repeats the block up to .endr once for each character in string bound to param.

directives.name: .endr
directives.description: Ends a repeat block started by .rept, .irp, or .irpc.

directives.name: .equ
directives.description: Assigns the constant value of expression to symbol.

directives.name: .set
directives.description: Sets symbol to the value of expression; may be reassigned later.

directives.name: .equiv
directives.description: Assigns expression to symbol and errors if symbol is already defined.

directives.name: .if
directives.description: Assembles the following block if expression evaluates to non-zero.

directives.name: .ifdef
directives.description: Assembles the following block if symbol is defined.

directives.name: .ifndef
directives.description: Assembles the following block if symbol is not defined.

directives.name: .else
directives.description: Begins the fallback branch of a conditional assembly block.

directives.name: .elseif
directives.description: Evaluates an additional condition if preceding branches of the .if block were false.

directives.name: .endif
directives.description: Ends a conditional assembly block.

directives.name: .ifc
directives.description: Assembles the following block if the two string arguments are identical.

directives.name: .ifnc
directives.description: Assembles the following block if the two string arguments differ.

directives.name: .ifb
directives.description: Assembles the following block if the argument text is blank.

directives.name: .ifnb
directives.description: Assembles the following block if the argument text is not blank.

directives.name: .ifeq
directives.description: Assembles the following block if expression equals zero.

directives.name: .ifne
directives.description: Assembles the following block if expression is not equal to zero.

directives.name: .iflt
directives.description: Assembles the following block if expression is less than zero.

directives.name: .ifle
directives.description: Assembles the following block if expression is less than or equal to zero.

directives.name: .ifgt
directives.description: Assembles the following block if expression is greater than zero.

directives.name: .ifge
directives.description: Assembles the following block if expression is greater than or equal to zero.

directives.name: .include
directives.description: Inserts and assembles the contents of the specified source file.

directives.name: .incbin
directives.description: Includes raw binary bytes from file directly into the current section.

directives.name: .pushsection
directives.description: Pushes the current section onto the section stack and switches to the specified section.

directives.name: .popsection
directives.description: Restores the previous section from the section stack.

directives.name: .previous
directives.description: Swaps the current section with the most recently active section.

directives.name: .subsection
directives.description: Switches to the numbered subsection within the current section.

directives.name: .cfi_startproc
directives.description: Marks the beginning of a function for DWARF Call Frame Information (CFI) generation.

directives.name: .cfi_endproc
directives.description: Marks the end of a function started by .cfi_startproc and emits its FDE.

directives.name: .cfi_def_cfa
directives.description: Defines the Canonical Frame Address (CFA) rule as register plus offset.

directives.name: .cfi_def_cfa_offset
directives.description: Updates the CFA offset while keeping the current CFA base register.

directives.name: .cfi_def_cfa_register
directives.description: Updates the CFA base register while keeping the current CFA offset.

directives.name: .cfi_offset
directives.description: Records that the previous value of register is saved at CFA + offset.

directives.name: .cfi_restore
directives.description: Restores the unwind rule for register to its initial state.

directives.name: .cfi_remember_state
directives.description: Saves the current CFI register rules onto an internal stack.

directives.name: .cfi_restore_state
directives.description: Restores CFI register rules from the internal stack.

directives.name: .reloc
directives.description: Emits an explicit relocation entry at offset.

directives.name: .print
directives.description: Prints message to standard output during assembly.

directives.name: .warning
directives.description: Emits an assembler warning with message without stopping assembly.

directives.name: .error
directives.description: Emits an assembler error with message.

directives.name: .err
directives.description: Emits an unconditional assembler error at the current location.

directives.name: .abort
directives.description: Aborts assembly immediately.

directives.name: .type
directives.description: Sets the ELF symbol type attribute for symbol.

directives.name: .size
directives.description: Sets the ELF symbol size attribute for symbol.

directives.name: .weak
directives.description: Marks one or more symbols as having weak ELF binding.

directives.name: .local
directives.description: Marks one or more symbols as local to the current object file.

directives.name: .hidden
directives.description: Sets ELF symbol visibility to hidden.

directives.name: .protected
directives.description: Sets ELF symbol visibility to protected.

directives.name: .internal
directives.description: Sets ELF symbol visibility to internal.

directives.name: .comm
directives.description: Declares a common symbol of size bytes (with optional alignment).

directives.name: .lcomm
directives.description: Reserves size bytes in the local BSS section for symbol.

directives.name: .balign
directives.description: Advances the location counter to a multiple of alignment bytes.

directives.name: .p2align
directives.description: Advances the location counter to a multiple of 2^power bytes.

directives.name: .space
directives.description: Emits size bytes initialized to fill (default zero).

directives.name: .skip
directives.description: Alias for .space; emits size bytes initialized to fill (default zero).

directives.name: .fill
directives.description: Emits repeat copies of a size-byte field set to value.

directives.name: .org
directives.description: Advances the current section offset to offset, padding with fill.

directives.name: .ident
directives.description: Places an identification string into the .comment section.

directives.name: .file
directives.description: Records source file information for ELF symbol table or DWARF debug line tables.

directives.name: .loc
directives.description: Emits DWARF debug line number table information for the current address.

directives.name: .symver
directives.description: Associates an ELF symbol version alias with a symbol.

directives.name: .global
directives.description: Makes symbol visible to the linker across object files (alias for .globl).

directives.name: .extern
directives.description: Ignored compatibility directive indicating an external symbol.

directives.name: .sleb128
directives.description: Emits signed LEB128 variable-length encoded integers.

directives.name: .uleb128
directives.description: Emits unsigned LEB128 variable-length encoded integers.
